finalText:
Connection leak was in `processOrder.js` — when the `run()` callback threw (like on invalid order payloads), the release never fired because there was no try-finally. Workers failed their jobs, connections got stuck in the inUse set, and the pool exhausted to zero available.

The API handlers used the safe `withConnection` wrapper with try-finally, so they recovered fine. But `processOrder` was manually acquiring and releasing, leaving a gap. Fixed it by wrapping the await in try-finally. All tests pass now.
